notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.content:
Hello diligent cartographers🗺️ !
We just uploaded a new patch for the demo and these are the things we addressed:

[list]
[*] Fixed getting stuck in the treasure found screen after respawning,
[*] Fixed jump breaking after cancelling step count midair,
[*] Fixed tab captions disappearing in options menu when switching the language,
[*] Fixed flying trees,
[/list]

Thank you for playing and we will keep you updated with further improvements we're adding! ✨

And consider leaving a review on our demo page to share your feedback!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672480/Map_Map__A_Game_About_Maps_Demo/

notes.title: Monthly Dev Log #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

and welcome to our very first Monthly Dev Log! [i]So exciting[/i] 

In order to keep you up to date, we thought that something like a monthly "newsletter" would be great.
So once a month we want to tell you what we've been working on in the last few weeks. If there's anything in particular you're interested in, let us know.
So here is what we worked on the last couple of weeks:

[h2]Art[/h2][list]
    [*]started with ideas and first sketches for a second biome
    [*]created the concept art for a chest and a shovel 
    [*]designed and implemented seagulls
[/list]

[h2]Audio[/h2]  [list]
    [*]recorded new footprint sounds (which are actually live sounds from our workation in Denmark)
[/list]

[h2]Programming[/h2]  [list]
    [*]Setup of a first save system
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]  [list]
    [*]We launched our official Discord community server (if you haven't joined our lovely community yet, head over [url=https://discord.gg/W47cSBnmE7]there[/url])
[/list]

We wish you all a fantastic day!
